items.title: Explicit Discontinuance and Switching Signals in Generative AI Applications: A Comparative Analysis across Nine Apps
items.abstract: This study examines explicitly reported discontinuance and platform-switching signals in Turkish- and English-language Google Play reviews of nine generative artificial intelligence applications. A total of 1,145,267 reviews posted between 1 July 2025 and 30 June 2026 were screened using rule-based procedures. Of 11,960 candidate reviews, 821 that met strict contextual rules were evaluated in two blind AI-assisted coding passes. The final high-confidence analysis set comprised 692 records, including 543 signals in which discontinuance or switching was reported as having occurred and 149 signals expressing discontinuance intention. To assess the recall limitation of the strict screen, an additional application-by-language stratified sample of 500 reviews was audited from the broader pool of 11,139 records, revealing 110 missed explicit signals. The stratified weighted estimate of the proportion of missed explicit signals in the broad pool was 21.6% (95% CI: 18.2%-25.2%). Accordingly, rates reported per 10,000 reviews are interpreted as high-confidence detection indicators rather than prevalence estimates. Within the high-confidence set, the most frequent reasons were response quality/task failure, technical problems, privacy/trust, and pricing. Among platform switches reported as having occurred, Gemini and Claude were the most frequent destinations. By separating intention from signals of reported enacted behavior and by explicitly reporting screening sensitivity, this study provides complementary evidence to the post-adoption literature on generative AI.

items.title: From Ancient Records to Agentic Intelligence: A Comprehensive Historical Review of Data Science and Its Role in Intelligent Internet of Things Analytics
items.abstract: Since the era of the Mesopotamia between 2900 BCE - 2350 BCE, the goals of “data science-like” approaches have always revolved around collecting fragments of information and trying to make insights out of such information. Data Science was not clearly termed as Data Science from the onset. Moreover, there exists several questions about Data Science just been a polished name for Statistics. Therefore, there is a need to look carefully at how Data Science has evolved over the years and where it is currently. The study defines Data Science as a multidisciplinary field that integrates statistics, mathematics, computer science, domain expertise, and ethics. This is important because, it will give Data Scientists and the Data Science enthusiasts a clear understanding of this discipline. In addition, the paper demonstrates how Data Science transforms massive Internet of Things (IoT) data streams into actionable insights through predictive analytics, anomaly detection, explainable artificial intelligence, cybersecurity analytics, digital twins, and intelligent decision support. The findings reveal that the evolution of Data Science reflects a transition from descriptive statistical analysis to autonomous, explainable, and trustworthy intelligent systems capable of supporting real-time decision-making across diverse domains. This work provides a unified historical perspective, highlights emerging research directions, and offers a valuable reference for researchers, educators, and practitioners seeking to understand the past, present, and future direction of Data Science.

items.title: From MSCA Proposal to the Ubuntu-Duende Lab: Embodiment, Digital Pedagogy, and the Intrinsic Pace of the Body
items.abstract: In this paper, I articulate the transition from my 2025 Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Postdoctoral Fellowship proposal into an independent, sovereign research lab. The MSCA proposal entitled DUENDE: Decolonial Ubuntu Embodiment for New Dance Epistemologies, was conceptualised as an exploratory research design for a two-year Practice-as-Research (PaR) study at the University of Granada. Its purpose was to propose and test an accessible digital pedagogy for the transcultural transmission of Flamenco in resource-constrained environments. I explain how centering embodiment as my primary epistemology exposed a fundamental tension between institutional grant timelines and the physical limits of the human body. In an era dominated by Large Language Models (LLMs) and hyper-accelerated "Fast Science," somatic integration, habitus, and tissue memory operate on an un-hurried, non-linear tempo. By depositing a summaries of the MSCA proposal methodology, workplan, and flow diagram on on Zenodo as an open-access research blueprint, I pivot away from administrative grant structures to launch the Ubuntu Duende Lab (fea-udl). Grounded in daily living practice, Substack peer-review (@kitaraflamenca), and low-bandwidth digital tools subverted for sovereign pedagogy, this paper establishes an autonomous research framework designed to unfold at the intrinsic speed of the body.
